article.title: Replacement of vehicles.
article.content: The holder of a permit may, with the permission of the authority by which the permit was granted, replace any vehicle covered by the permit by any other vehicle of the same nature.
article.html:
83Replacement of vehicles.

Section 83 · Chapter V · page 60 of the Act

The holder of a permit may, with the permission of the authority by which the permit was granted, replace any vehicle covered by the permit by any other vehicle of the same nature.
